page.overview:
Who is Black Whore?

The Black Whore (also known as Abigail Dexter) is a fictional character created by American author Kevin L. O'Brien for his 2006 short story "October Surprise".

After merging with Doctor Ambrose Dexter and turning him into a new avatar for himself, Nyarlathotep impregnated Dexter’s wife with his own seed; the resultant child, Abigail Dexter, would therefore be Nyarlathotep's avatar from birth.

As an adult, Abigail earned her doctorate in nuclear physics and took a post with the United States government. She then masterminded a plot to detonate a nuclear weapon underwater to destroy a Deep One city; this fulfilled the schemes' primary goal of cracking an Elder Sign which held the Great Old One Cthaeghya in imprisonment. (: "October Surprise")

Abigail Dexter's current whereabouts are unknown.
